drafted_from: tool:put-an-object-in-an-s3-store row in tool-rows.json, do-work/put-object.mjs and test/put-object.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Put App.dmg from my release folder into my downloads store as App-202611241617.dmg." It runs tool:put-an-object-in-an-s3-store with that folder granted and answers the size, SHA-256 and address of the object.
no_lists_because: It names no list: it writes one file into one key of a bucket whose key the person keeps in their vault.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's five values in your vault under one name: <store>-key-id, <store>-secret, <store>-endpoint (an https root), <store>-bucket and <store>-region, each reaching only the store's host. The key never appears in a request.

2. Say which file in which folder goes to which key; your AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account with method tools:run, tool tool:put-an-object-in-an-s3-store and input {store, file, key, content_type, cache_control?, computer: {"read-a-folder": {folder}}}.
3. Read the answer: key, size, sha256, the store's etag and the address the object was put at. A public bucket serves it to anyone from then on; putting the same key again replaces it.
4. If the store refuses the key (401 or 403), keep a current key for that store in the vault.

worked_examples.title: Put an update feed at its fixed key
worked_examples.ask: Put appcast.xml into my downloads store at appcast.xml, cached for one minute.
worked_examples.given: From tools/put-an-object-in-an-s3-store/test/put-object.test.mjs: the store's made-up endpoint https://s3.example-region-1.store.example.test, bucket example-downloads and region example-region-1, and a 27-byte appcast.xml in the granted folder. The tool sends one PUT to that endpoint only, signed for example-region-1 with the file's SHA-256 as the payload hash.
worked_examples.hands_back: {key, size: 27, sha256: <the file's SHA-256>, etag: "abc123", address: "https://s3.example-region-1.store.example.test/example-downloads/..."}. A 403 from the store answers "The store refused the held key (403). Keep a current key for downloads-store in the vault."
